description: Prepare for travel, a job interview, a work meeting, or everyday conversation with short Talkio role-plays. Your assistant conducts the exercise, offers hints, and gives feedback on your replies. No Talkio account is required. Voice depends on the host. This plugin does not provide acoustic pronunciation scores or save progress to Talkio. An optional informational link explains Talkio and this practice activity. No purchases or subscription upgrades are offered.

defaultPrompt: Help me practise ordering food in Spanish before my holiday.
I have a German job interview. Practise with me.
Help me speak more confidently in English meetings.
